column1: 30251§livid§ˈlɪvɪd§adj. 青紫色的；铅灰色的；暴怒的；（气得）脸色发青的§… the sun, already down, was manifest in the livid tongues of fire darting towards the zenith …§……已落下的太阳，化作一片片**青灰色**的火舌朝天顶窜去……§§§§livid tongues of fire 青灰色的火舌§SAT 常考「颜色义 vs 愤怒义」的语境切换§改译文：英文只是中间一段，删去英文里没有的前后部分

30252§lofty§ˈlɒfti§adj. 高耸的；高峻的；崇高的；高傲的§“The beauty of such objects,” writes Sōetsu Yanagi in The Unknown Craftsman, “is not so much of the noble, the huge, or the lofty as a beauty of the warm and familiar.”§「这类器物之美，与其说在于高贵、宏大或**崇高**，不如说在于温暖而亲切之美。」柳宗悦在《Unknown Craftsman》中如此写道。§§§§lofty cliffs / ceilings 高耸的悬崖 / 天花板；lofty ideals 崇高理想；lofty manner 高傲的态度；loftiness n. 高耸；崇高；高傲§loft 是名词「阁楼」，aloft 是副词「在高处」；「高傲」义带贬义§改例句：删去混入的「Text 2」标签及其后一句，句首补上漏掉的左引号；改译文：相应删去后半

30253§metallurgy§məˈtælədʒi§n. 冶金学；冶金术§The single origin hypothesis of iron metallurgy posits that the craft originated in Anatolia (West Asia) circa 2200–2000 BCE before diffusing to other parts of the world, including Africa.§铁**冶金术**的单一起源假说认为，这门工艺约在公元前2200至2000年起源于安纳托利亚（西亚），随后才扩散到包括非洲在内的世界其他地区。§Research by Nathaniel Erb-Satullo reveals an important exception: gold metallurgy flourished in the Caucasus in the Bronze Age, but a steep drop during that time (circa 1500 BCE) in objects featuring gold filigree (in which fine threads of gold are arranged in intricate patterns) and other sophisticated goldsmithing techniques suggests that simpler processes supplanted advanced methods.§Nathaniel Erb-Satullo 的研究揭示了一个重要例外：青铜时代，金**冶金术**曾在高加索地区兴盛，但同一时期（约公元前 1500 年）饰有金丝细工（把细金丝排成繁复图案）及运用其他精湛金匠技艺的器物骤然减少，这表明较简单的工艺取代了先进的方法。§metal + -urgy（…工艺）§iron / gold metallurgy 铁 / 金冶金术；metallurgist n. 冶金学家；metallurgical adj. 冶金的§metallurgy ≠ meteorology：后者是「气象学」，形近异义§补译文2

30254§monotony§məˈnɒtəni§n. 单调；千篇一律；乏味§Padre Florentino was relieving the monotony by playing on his harmonium sad and melancholy tunes, to which the sonorous roar of the surf and the sighing of the treetops of the neighboring wood served as accompaniments.§弗洛伦蒂诺神父正用簧风琴弹些哀婉的曲调排遣这份**单调**，而浪涛洪亮的轰鸣与邻近林间树梢的飒飒声，正好作了伴奏。§§§monotonous adj. 单调的§relieve the monotony 排遣单调§与 uniformity（均一）不同，带主观厌烦色彩§改译文：删去英文里没有的前半（独居海滨、窗外海景）

30255§mournful§ˈmɔːnfl§adj. 哀伤的；悲伤的；忧郁的§With its mournful subject matter and haunting tune, “Silver Dagger” is one of the most celebrated folk ballads of the southern Appalachian Mountains.§《银匕首》题材**哀伤**、曲调萦绕，是南阿巴拉契亚山区最负盛名的民谣之一。§Notes long, full, mournful as a prayer, yet still vigorous, escaped from the old instrument.§悠长、饱满、如祈祷般**哀伤**却依然有力的音符，从那件旧乐器上流淌而出。§mourn（哀悼）+ -ful§mournful tune / subject matter 哀伤的曲调 / 题材；mourn v. 哀悼；mourning n. 哀悼（期）；somber / elegiac adj. 阴郁的 / 挽歌式的（近义）§别与动词过去式 mourned 混§

30256§naturalistic§ˌnætʃrəˈlɪstɪk§adj. 仿自然的；自然的；自然主义的；写实的§The students compared wild-type mice and knockout mice, which are mice with specific genes deactivated, when mice of each type were raised in similar naturalistic environments and periodically tested for cataracts.§学生们比较了野生型小鼠与基因敲除小鼠（特定基因被失活的小鼠），两类小鼠分别在相似的**自然化**环境中饲养，并定期接受白内障检测。§The study’s superimposition analysis showed that these Linear Naturalistic Figures (LNF) consistently appear on top of Gwion and underneath Wanjina figures.§该研究的叠置分析显示：这些「线性**自然主义**人物」一致出现在 Gwion 人物之上、Wanjina 人物之下。§§naturalistic environments / settings 仿自然环境；naturalistic observation 自然观察法（研究方法术语）；naturalism n. 自然主义；naturalist n. 博物学家§naturalistic 是「仿自然的 / 自然主义的」学术义，不同于 natural§

30257§nurture§ˈnɜːtʃə(r)§v. 培育；养育；滋养 n. 养育；教养§They shared a vision of a theater company that would nurture and showcase the work of Black theater professionals.§他们共同怀有一个愿景：创办一家能够**培育**并展示黑人戏剧从业者作品的剧团。§In 1958, Jim Dine and several other emerging artists founded the Judson Gallery in New York City, a nurturing space where artists produced and exhibited works that were radically new at the time—from assemblages (mixed-media pieces with found objects) to "Happenings" (performance art experiences designed to be irreplicable).§1958 年，Jim Dine 与几位新兴艺术家在纽约创办了贾德森画廊——一个**培育**性的空间，艺术家在那里创作并展出当时极为激进的新作品：从拼装艺术（含现成物件的混合媒介作品）到「偶发艺术」（被设计成不可复现的行为艺术体验）。§§nurture talent / a vision 培养人才 / 愿景；nature versus nurture 先天与后天之争；nurturing adj. 培育性的；nourish v. 滋养（近义，偏物质营养）§nurture（后天教养）与 nature（天性）是经典对立§改例句2：Happenings 引号内多余空格，右引号与括号间漏空格

30258§oblige§əˈblaɪdʒ§v. 迫使；责成；施惠于；（be obliged）感激§It is so much easier to make up your mind that your neighbour is good for nothing, than to enter into all the circumstances that would oblige you to modify that opinion.§断定你的邻居一无是处，远比去了解那些会**迫使**你修正这一看法的所有情况来得容易。§§§§oblige sb to do sth 迫使某人做某事；be obliged to do 不得不做；be much obliged 感激不尽（旧式礼貌语）；obligation n. 义务；obligatory adj. 强制的；obliged adj. 感激的；被迫的§oblige（迫使 / 施惠）≠ obligate（法律上强制），真题多取「迫使」义；oblivion 是「被遗忘」，形近异义§

30259§obliterate§əˈblɪtəreɪt§v. 彻底摧毁；抹去；使湮灭；使无法辨认§The fog extended its tentacles over city and river, gradually obliterating traces of familiar landscapes. At five-thirty the old Panhandle bridge, supported by massive sandstone pillars, stalwart, as when erected fifty years before to serve a generation now passed behind the portals of life, had become a spectral outline against the sky.§雾把它的触手伸向城市与河流，渐渐**抹去**了熟悉景致的痕迹。五点半时，那座由巨大砂岩桥墩支撑的老 Panhandle 桥——依旧坚固，一如五十年前为服务如今已逝去的一代人而建成之时——已成了天幕上一个幽灵般的轮廓。§§§§obliterate traces / evidence 抹去痕迹 / 证据；obliteration n. 彻底毁灭；抹除；eradicate / expunge v. 根除 / 删去（近义）§与 oblige / oblique 形近异义§改译文：补译漏掉的第二句（Panhandle 桥）

30260§obviate§ˈɒbvieɪt§v. 消除；排除；使成为不必要§Linguist John McWhorter asserts that translation apps for smartphones and computers are—despite generally failing to convey many nuances—increasingly obviating the need to learn new languages.§语言学家 John McWhorter 断言，尽管手机和电脑上的翻译应用通常无法传达许多细微之处，它们正在日益**消除**学习新语言的必要性。§… obviating the need for manufacturers to conduct costly and intrusive sampling of vertebrate species—such as Perez’s frogs (Pelophylax perezi) …§……从而**免去**制造商对脊椎动物——如佩雷兹氏蛙——进行昂贵且具侵入性的采样……§ob-（相对）+ via（路）→ 把路上的障碍挪开§obviate the need for / to do 免去…的必要；obviation n. 消除；排除；preclude / eliminate the need 排除 / 免去必要（近义）§与 obvious（明显的）同根但词性不同§

30261§ocular§ˈɒkjələ§adj. 眼睛的；视觉的；目视的§Certain species, such as Hay's Spring amphipods (Stygobromus hayi), lack functional eyes or ocular organs altogether and rely on other mechanisms for navigation.§某些物种，例如海氏泉钩虾（Stygobromus hayi），完全没有具功能的眼睛或**视觉**器官，只能依靠其他机制导航。§§§§ocular organs 视觉器官§书面 / 解剖学用语，日常用 visual / eye；与 oracle（神谕）、oracular 拼写近而义远§

30262§oeuvre§ˈɜːvrə§n. （作家、艺术家的）全部作品；毕生创作§Blatt concluded that in Hemingway's oeuvre, there is a negative correlation between -ly adverb proliferation and perceived literary merit.§布拉特得出结论：在海明威的**全部作品**中，-ly 副词的使用密度与读者所感知的文学价值呈负相关。§§§§§出版语境指经整理的全集；单篇作品不用此词§

30263§oppress§əˈpres§v. 压迫；压制；使烦恼；使窒息§… a crisis in confidence in the currency occurred in Sidon around 367 BCE, which was likely relieved—despite Sidon’s persistent oppressive financial obligations …§……约公元前 367 年，西顿发生了对这种货币的信心危机；尽管西顿持续背负**沉重**的财政义务，这场危机很可能还是得到了缓解……§§§oppression n. 压迫；oppressive adj. 压制性的；闷热的§§Dickinson 诗 Without oppress of Toll 里 oppress 作名词，指「不受通行税盘剥」；oppressive 的「压制性 / 闷热」两义都常考§

30264§palatability§ˌpælətəˈbɪləti§n. 适口性；可口程度；（观点、方案的）可接受程度§Pablo Sebastián Padrón et al. investigated the acoustic properties of moths' ultrasonic responses to audio of bat echolocation and then assessed the palatability of the ultrasound-producing moths.§巴勃罗·塞巴斯蒂安·帕德龙等人研究了蛾类对蝙蝠回声定位音频发出超声回应时的声学特征，随后评估了这些发出超声的蛾子的**适口性**。§On ingesting a piece of milkweed, the monarch selectively absorbs toxic cardenolides from the plant in its gut and stores them in the tissues throughout its body, rendering the butterfly unpalatable to predators.§摄食一块马利筋后，黑脉金斑蝶会在肠道中选择性吸收植物中的有毒强心甾，储存于全身组织中，令捕食者**难以下咽**。§§assess the palatability 评估适口性；unpalatable adj. 难吃的；难以接受的（真题出现 1 次）§生物 / 食品语境指食物对取食者的可口程度，直接影响捕食选择§

30265§participatory§pɑːˌtɪsɪˈpeɪtəri§adj. 参与式的；人人参与的§Although it represents the hybridization of the Indigenous dance traditions of Mexico with dances brought there by Spanish colonizers beginning in the 1500s, baile folklórico emerged with its present array of formal attributes only in the 1950s, when choreographer Amalia Hernández adapted the traditionally participatory dances of Mexico for performance before a passive audience in a theater setting, interpolating into them elements of the staging and elaborate choreography of modern dance and classical ballet.§尽管 baile folklórico 代表着墨西哥原住民舞蹈传统与16世纪起西班牙殖民者带来的舞蹈的融合，它呈现出如今这套形式特征却要到20世纪50年代——当时编舞家 Amalia Hernández 把墨西哥原本**人人参与**的传统舞蹈改编为剧场里供被动观众观看的表演，并在其中插入了现代舞与古典芭蕾的场面调度与繁复编排元素。§§§§participatory dance / democracy 参与式舞蹈 / 民主；participate v. 参与；participation n. 参与；participant n. 参与者（真题高频）§participatory ≠ participial（语法：分词的）；participative 近义，SAT 取前者§改译文：补漏译的 interpolating 分句

30266§perishable§ˈperɪʃəbl§adj. 易腐烂的；易变质的；（抽象）短暂易逝的§Plant-based artifacts, including wooden utensils, are seldom studied due to their perishable nature.§植物类遗物——包括木制器具——因**易腐坏**而很少被研究。§§§§perishable nature 易腐的特性§考古阅读里解释「植物类遗物为何少被研究」的关键因果词§

30267§perplex§pəˈpleks§v. 使困惑；使费解§Ever since fossilized remains of this large ammonite were first discovered in 1895, scientists have been perplexed by its size.§自1895年这种大型菊石的化石遗骸首次被发现以来，科学家一直对它的体型感到**困惑**。§Tropical forests across the globe provide similar preservation conditions, so in all likelihood, this rather perplexing timeline simply reflected geographic differences in the extent of paleoanthropological research.§全球热带森林提供相似的保存条件，因此这一**令人困惑**的时间线，很可能只是反映了古人类学研究在地域上的深浅差异。§§be perplexed by / at 对…感到困惑；perplexing adj. 令人费解的；perplexed adj. 困惑的；perplexity n. 困惑；复杂难解；puzzle / baffle v. 使迷惑 / 使难倒（近义）§与 complex（复杂的）形近异义§改译文：补漏译的 large ammonite 与 first

30268§pidgin§ˈpɪdʒɪn§n. 洋泾浜语；皮钦语（混杂语言）§English-lexifying creoles in the Caribbean, such as Vincentian Creole, rely on West African substrates, while Hawaiian Pidgin relies on 'Olelo Hawai'i, the Polynesian language of the Native Hawaiian people, with further contributions from Okinawan and other East Asian languages, Portuguese, and Spanish.§加勒比地区以英语为词汇来源的克里奥尔语（如文森特克里奥尔语）依赖西非底层语，而夏威夷**洋泾浜**则依赖夏威夷原住民的波利尼西亚语 'Olelo Hawai'i，并额外吸收了冲绳及东亚其他语言、葡萄牙语和西班牙语的成分。§§§§§不同语言群体为临时交际拼成的简化混合语，无人以其为母语；与 creole（已成为母语的克里奥尔语）严格对举§

30269§plausible§ˈplɔːzəbl§adj. 貌似可信的；说得通的；合理的§Invented by Bing, the characters present plausibly and grandiosely, inviting yet punishing those who yearn to decode them.§这些人物由 Bing 虚构而成，表现得既**可信**又浮夸，吸引着渴望解读他们的人，却又让这些人吃尽苦头。§However, carbonate dissolution is very unlikely to have occurred in the vicinity of Nadir, and although subsurface salt withdrawal could have plausibly occurred in this area and would result in a depression with a terraced floor or a circular shape, it would not exhibit the area of central uplift seen at Nadir.§然而，Nadir 附近极不可能发生碳酸盐溶解；尽管地下盐层抽离在该区域**确有可能**发生并会形成梯状洼地或圆形凹陷，它不会呈现 Nadir 所见的中央隆起区。§§§含「未必定真」的保留语气；反义 implausible；plausibly adv. 可信地；似乎有理地§改译文：原译是另一句（地外生命与宜居带）的翻译，按英文重译

30270§polity§ˈpɒləti§n. 政治体；政治实体；政体§Pointing to the rapid economic development of Singapore and other polities under market capitalism, advocates of developmental-state theory hold that the formal enforcement of meritocratic hiring and other bureaucratic initiatives enable growth.§发展型国家理论的倡导者以新加坡以及市场资本主义下的其他**政治体**为例，主张对唯贤用人制度的正式落实以及其他官僚体制举措能够促进增长。§§§§political adj. 政治的；politician n. 政治家；state / regime n. 国家 / 政权（近义）§polity（政治共同体）≠ policy（政策）≠ politics（政治活动）；与 police 形近§

30271§polymath§ˈpɒlimæθ§n. 博学者；通才；全才§It should be judged not just in the context of Piketty's previous work but placed next to books like Robert Burton's Anatomy of Melancholy, in which the stated theme of the varieties of melancholy is mainly an excuse for a polymath to map his own mind.§评判这本书，不应只放在皮凯蒂既往著作的脉络里，还该把它与罗伯特·伯顿《忧郁的解剖》一类书并置——后者名义上谈忧郁的种种变体，实则不过给一位**博学之士**提供了描摹自己心绪的由头。§§§poly-（多）+ -math（学）→ polymath§§与 specialist（专才）对举§

30272§ponder§ˈpɒndə(r)§v. 沉思；仔细考虑；琢磨§Readers sometimes divide the works of twentieth-century English author Evelyn Waugh into two periods: one consisting of his early satirical novels and the other consisting of his later, more serious—even ponderous—books.§读者有时把二十世纪英国作家伊夫林·沃的作品分为两个时期：一是他早期的讽刺小说，二是他后期那些更严肃——甚至**沉闷**——的作品。§§§§ponder a question / whether 思考某问题 / 是否…；pondering adj. 沉思的；ponderous adj. 笨重的；（文风）沉闷的（同根但义已分叉）；contemplate / deliberate v. 深思 / 斟酌（近义）§ponder（慢而深地想）≠ wonder（想知道、感到好奇）；本例句用的是 ponderous§改译文：原译是另一段（踱步挂画）的翻译，按英文重译

30273§prance§prɑːns§v. （马）昂首腾跃；（人）神气活现地走；欢跃 n. 腾跃§Coursers like a Page Of prancing Poetry—This Traverse may the poorest take Without oppress of Toll ——How frugal is the Chariot That bears the Human soul.§也没有任何骏马能像一页**腾跃**的诗——这趟旅程连最穷的人也负担得起，无需缴纳通行税：承载人类灵魂的这辆车辇，是何等俭省。§§§§§Dickinson 诗 prancing Poetry 以「腾跃的诗行」喻书页载人之疾§改例句：诗行换行处漏空格（PageOf、takeWithout、ChariotThat）；改译文：删去英文没有的括号说明

30274§preclude§prɪˈkluːd§v. 排除；阻止；使不可能§Piezoelectric harvesters convert kinetic energy (resonance) to electrical energy, precluding the need for external electrical sources.§压电采集器把动能（共振）转换为电能，因而**省去**了外接电源的必要。§§§§preclude the need for X 免除对 X 的需要；preclude sb from doing 使某人不能做；preclusion n. 排除；阻止§比 prevent 更书面，更强调「前提上就不成立」§

30275§prescriptive§prɪˈskrɪptɪv§adj. 规定性的；规范性的；指令性的§… untethered from any prescriptive agenda …§……不受任何**规定性**议程束缚……§§§§prescribe v. 开处方；规定（真题出现 3 次）§语言学里与 descriptive（描写性）严格对举§改译文：英文只是中间片段，删去英文里没有的前后部分

30276§pristine§ˈprɪstiːn§adj. 原始状态的；未受破坏的；崭新的；洁净的§Even though Florida was rapidly being developed at that time, tourists in particular held the idea that its distinctive tropical and coastal environments represented a pristine natural world, untouched by modernity.§尽管当时的佛罗里达正被迅速开发，游客们尤其抱持着这样一种观念：它独特的热带与海岸环境代表着一个未被现代性触碰的**纯净**自然世界。§For example, the Puerto Rican municipality of Hatillo has also been called "the Blue Coast of Puerto Rico," a nickname that alludes to what the area is well known for: the pristine blue ocean that surrounds it.§再如，波多黎各的哈蒂约市也被称为「波多黎各的蓝色海岸」——这个别名暗指该地闻名之处：环绕其侧的**原始**蔚蓝海洋。§§pristine forest / environment 原始森林 / 未受破坏的环境；pristine condition 崭新的状态；pristinely adv. 纯净地；untouched / unspoiled adj. 未受触碰的 / 未被破坏的（近义）§真题两义皆现：自然环境「原始未受破坏」与物品「崭新」§

30277§prolong§prəˈlɒŋ§v. 延长；拉长；拖延§Prolonged exposure to anthropogenic noise (sounds from human sources like traffic or mining) can affect animals, as Kirsty Elizabeth McLaughlin and Hansjoerg P.§**长期**暴露于人为噪声（来自交通或采矿等人类来源的声音）会影响动物，正如 Kirsty Elizabeth McLaughlin 与 Hansjoerg P. ……§§§pro-（向前）+ long（长）§prolong exposure / life / a debate 延长暴露 / 寿命 / 辩论；prolonged adj. 长期的（prolonged exposure 长期暴露，真题高频）；prolongation n. 延长§没有 prolongate 一词§改译文：英文在人名处截断，删去英文没有的「在对……的研究中所发现的」

30278§proportionality§prəˌpɔːʃəˈnæləti§n. 比例（关系）；相称；正比关系§Hopi/Choctaw painter Linda Lomahaftewa largely eschews the European tradition of figurative painting, with its proportionality of human form and depth between foreground and background; instead, she assembles compositions out of abstract motifs common in the ceramics and other traditional arts of the Hopi Tribe, thus ensuring cultural continuity.§霍皮／乔克托画家 Linda Lomahaftewa 在很大程度上避开了欧洲具象绘画传统——那种讲究人体**比例**、讲究前景与背景之间纵深关系的传统；相反，她用霍皮部落陶器及其他传统艺术中常见的抽象母题来组织画面，从而确保了文化的延续。§Muscogee painter Marcus Harjo often eschews the European tradition of figurative painting, with its proportionality of human form and depth between foreground and background; instead, he assembles compositions out of abstract motifs common in the traditional beadwork and graphic art of his own tribe, thus ensuring cultural continuity.§马斯科吉画家 Marcus Harjo 常避开欧洲具象绘画传统——那种人体**比例**考究、前景背景层次分明的画法；转而以本部落传统珠饰与平面艺术中常见的抽象母题来构筑画面，从而确保文化的延续。§§proportionality of human form 人体比例；proportionality constant 比例常数；proportional adj. 成比例的；proportionate adj. 相称的；proportion n. 比例；部分（真题高频）§与 inverse proportionality（反比关系）相对§

30279§proverb§ˈprɒvɜːb§n. 谚语；格言§Chile compiling extensive records of authentic folk music as well as recipes, proverbs, and other facets of cultural history.§……智利，为真实的民间音乐，也为食谱、**谚语**以及文化史的方方面面，编成了详尽的记录。§§§§§与 adage / maxim / aphorism 近义；真题把 recipes, proverbs 并列为民俗记录的具体门类§改译文：英文从 Chile 起是残句，删去英文没有的「帕拉走遍」

30280§pseudonym§ˈsuːdənɪm§n. 笔名；假名；化名§The Silence of Dean Maitland is one of twenty-five works from the nineteenth and early twentieth centuries reissued in 2020 in a project professing to give overdue credit to authors by replacing nonfemale pseudonyms with the authors’ given female names (crediting Mary Tuttiett rather than Maxwell Gray, in this case).§《迪安·梅特兰的沉默》是2020年重版的十九世纪与二十世纪初的二十五部作品之一；这个重版项目宣称要给作者补上迟来的署名，即把非女性的**笔名**替换为作者本人的女性名字（就本书而言，即署名 Mary Tuttiett 而非 Maxwell Gray）。§Recognizing that women long had to use male pseudonyms for their works to be granted serious consideration (by publishers and readers alike), the campaign restored the authors’ given female names in place of such pseudonyms and brought visibility to identities that should not have been hidden.§该活动意识到：长久以来，女性的作品必须署男性**笔名**才能获得出版方与读者的认真对待，于是用作者的真实女性姓名替换了这些笔名，让本不该被遮蔽的身份重见天日。§pseudo-（假）+ -nym（名字）§write under a pseudonym 用笔名写作；pseudonymous adj. 用笔名的；nom de plume / pen name n. 笔名（近义）§pseudo- 表「伪、假」，同 pseudoscience（伪科学）§改译文：补漏译的括号内容（Mary Tuttiett、Maxwell Gray）；改例句2：删去混入的「Text 2」标签及其后一句；改译文2：相应删去后半

30281§pulverize§ˈpʌlvəraɪz§v. 粉碎；把…磨成粉；彻底击败；摧毁§A research team led by Ariane da Silva Cardoso investigated pulverizing discarded Sururu mussel shells to create a substitute for fine aggregates (such as sand) in mortar mixtures.§由 Ariane da Silva Cardoso 领导的研究团队考察了把废弃的 Sururu 贻贝壳加以**粉碎**，用以替代砂浆混合料中的细骨料（如砂）。§After sample A0106 was retrieved from the asteroid Ryugu, a portion of it was subjected to an extraction protocol in which small amounts of pulverized material were rinsed, sequentially, with hexane, dichloromethane, methanol, and finally a mixture of dichloromethane and methanol.§从小行星龙宫取回样本 A0106 后，研究者对其中一部分执行了提取流程：将少量**研碎**的材料依次用己烷、二氯甲烷、甲醇、以及二氯甲烷和甲醇的混合液进行淋洗。§§pulverize shells / rock 把贝壳 / 岩石磨碎；pulverized adj. 粉碎的（pulverized material 粉碎后的物料）；pulverization n. 粉碎（作用）§pulverulent 是形容词「粉末状的」§

30283§quintessential§ˌkwɪntɪˈsenʃl§adj. 典型的；最典范的；精髓的§Apple’s introduction of the iPhone in 2007 is a quintessential instance of brand extension—the company leveraged its brand recognition as a computer manufacturer to enter a product category where it had not previously competed.§苹果公司 2007 年推出 iPhone，是品牌延伸的**典范**一例——公司利用其作为电脑制造商的品牌知名度，进入了一个此前从未竞争过的品类。§§§quintessence n. 精华；第五元素 → quintessential§a quintessential instance of… …的典范一例§语气强于 typical§

30286§reallocation§ˌriːæləˈkeɪʃn§n. 重新分配；再配置§In industrializing economies, urbanization and reallocation of labor from the agriculture sector to the manufacturing sector are strongly correlated.§在工业化经济体中，城市化与劳动力从农业部门向制造业部门的**重新配置**密切相关。§§§re-（重新）+ allocation（分配）§reallocation of labor 劳动力再配置（真题经济史类固定搭配）；reallocation of resources 资源再分配；reallocate v. 重新分配；allocate v. 分配§relocation 是「迁移、搬迁」§

30287§rearrangement§ˌriːəˈreɪndʒmənt§n. 重新排列；重新安排；（染色体）重排§Drosophila (fruit flies) have generation times of 10–12 days, so seasonal changes in food availability and other environmental conditions can drive seasonal fluctuations in chromosome rearrangements in species such as D. persimilis and D. subobscura.§果蝇的世代周期只有10至12天，因此食物供应及其他环境条件的季节变化会驱动 D. persimilis、D. subobscura 等物种染色体**重排**的季节性波动。§§§§chromosome rearrangement 染色体重排；rearrangement of furniture 家具的重新摆放；rearrange v. 重新排列；reorganization n. 重组（近义）§真题亦作比喻义「格局重组」§改译文：food availability 原译成「湿度」

30289§renown§rɪˈnaʊn§n. 名望；声誉；名声§Few of the personages of past times (except such as have gained renown in fireside legends as well as in written history) are anything but mere names to their successors.§往昔的人物中（除了那些在炉边传说与成文历史中都赢得**声名**者），对他们的后人而言几乎只是些空洞的名字。§Creek Council Tree (1967) and Cimarron Iron Bridge (1972) are two oil landscape paintings by renowned Pawnee Nation artist Brummett Echohawk.§《克里克议事树》（1967）与《西马龙铁桥》（1972）是波尼族**著名**艺术家 Brummett Echohawk 的两幅油画风景。§§of great / international renown 享有盛名 / 国际声誉的；renowned adj. 著名的；享有盛誉的（真题更常见此形）；fame / distinction n. 名声 / 卓越（近义）§rename 是「重命名」，形近异义§改例句：excerpt 是 except 之误

30290§restrain§rɪˈstreɪn§v. 抑制；制止；束缚；关押§They concluded that exercise training was more effective at restraining productivity loss than health promotion seminars were, though this result took time to become apparent.§他们得出结论：相较健康宣导研讨会，运动训练在**抑制**生产力损失方面更有效，尽管这一结果过了一段时间才显现出来。§RSRs are effective at protecting existing policyholders from price volatility, but Naoki Aizawa and Ami Ko note that since dynamic pricing of premiums is an important risk-mitigation tool for insurers, RSRs may lead some insurers to scale back or entirely cease selling new policies in the affected market, thereby reducing the competitive pressure that typically restrains premium prices for new policies.§费率稳定条款（RSR）能有效保护现有投保人免受价格波动影响；但 Naoki Aizawa 与 Ami Ko 指出：由于保费的动态定价是保险人重要的风险缓释工具，RSR 可能导致部分保险人缩减甚至完全停止在相关市场销售新保单，从而削弱通常能**抑制**新单保费的竞争压力。§§restrain growth / inflation / an impulse 抑制增长 / 通胀 / 冲动；restraint n. 克制；限制措施；restrained adj. 受限制的；克制的§restrain（主动抑制）≠ refrain（克制自己不做，后接 from）；constrain 偏「客观条件制约」§

30291§roseate§ˈrəʊziət§adj. 玫瑰色的；淡红的；（比喻）过于乐观的§They found that great blue herons prefer areas with deep water during breeding season, but that was not true for roseate spoonbills.§他们发现大蓝鹭在繁殖季偏爱深水区，但**粉红**琵鹭并非如此。§The great egret and the roseate spoonbill are long-legged birds that live in wetlands, like the Everglades in Florida.§大白鹭与**粉红**琵鹭都是生活在湿地（如佛罗里达大沼泽地）的长腿鸟类。§§roseate spoonbill 粉红琵鹭；a roseate view 过于乐观的看法§书面 / 诗语；真题以鸟名出现，是专名中的普通形容词§

30292§rotational§rəʊˈteɪʃənl§adj. 旋转的；转动的；自转的§Each planet in this system is so close in orbit to the star that the gravitational forces acting between the planet and the star cause the planet's rotational period around its axis and orbital period around the star to be equal.§该系统中的每颗行星在轨道上都离恒星极近，以至于行星与恒星之间的引力作用使行星绕自身轴的**自转**周期与绕恒星的公转周期相等。§Instead, Luu et al. are likely correct that 6478 Gault is shedding mass due to rotational instability.§相反，Luu 等人的判断很可能正确：6478 Gault 正因**自转**不稳定而散失质量。§rotate → rotation → rotational§rotational period 自转周期（真题天文类术语）；rotational instability 自转不稳定；rotate v. 旋转；rotation n. 旋转；自转§orbital period（公转周期）常与 rotational period 对举§

30293§rudimentary§ˌruːdɪˈmentri§adj. 初步的；基本的；简陋的；（器官）发育不全的；退化的§A 2025 study performed by Simon Townsend and colleagues presents evidence that bonobos, close relatives of chimpanzees, are capable of a rudimentary compositionality in communication—that is, they can organize sounds they make such that the order carries meaning in addition to the sounds themselves.§Simon Townsend 及其同事在2025年进行的一项研究提出证据表明，倭黑猩猩——黑猩猩的近亲——具备一种**初步**的组合性交流能力，即它们能把自己发出的声音加以组织，使声音本身之外，其先后次序也承载意义。§The fairly rudimentary nature of Malta’s lithic industry parallels contemporaneous Sardinian technologies rather than the sophisticated geometric microlith traditions documented in neighboring Sicily.§马耳他石器工业相对**原始**的面貌，与同期撒丁岛技术更为相近，而不同于邻近西西里有案可查的精细几何细石器传统。§§rudimentary knowledge / tools 基础知识 / 简陋工具；rudimentary wings 退化的翅膀；rudiment n. 雏形；基本原理（常用复数 rudiments）；primitive / elemental adj. 原始的 / 基本的（近义）§与 rude 同出拉丁语 rudis（原始、未加工），但 rude 已转义为「粗鲁的」§改译文：补漏译的 in addition to the sounds themselves

30294§scaffold§ˈskæfəʊld§n. 脚手架；（施工）支架；断头台；绞刑台；（抽象）支撑框架§… and we know very sensible men who would ascend the scaffold rather than enter a theater before the first act.§……我们也确知有些极明白的人，宁可登上**断头台**，也不肯在第一幕之前进剧场。§§§§ascend the scaffold 走上断头台；scaffolding n. 脚手架；（教学）支架式引导§真题 ascend the scaffold 与进剧场看戏对举，是反讽§改译文：英文只是末句片段，删去英文里没有的前文

30295§sculpt§skʌlpt§v. 雕刻；雕塑；塑造§According to historical documents, Marietta Strozzi—a young woman who was prominent in fifteenth-century Florentine culture—inspired several artworks, including a portrait bust sculpted by Desiderio da Settignano.§据史料记载，Marietta Strozzi——一位在十五世纪佛罗伦萨文化中声名显赫的年轻女子——启发了好几件艺术作品，其中包括 Desiderio da Settignano **雕刻**的一尊肖像半身像。§In doing so, the London-based Nigerian sculptor challenged viewers to imagine new uses and futures for the material wastes of the past.§通过此举，这位驻伦敦的尼日利亚**雕塑家**促使观者想象：过去时代的材料废弃物还能有哪些新用途与新未来。§sculptor n. 雕塑家；sculpture n. 雕塑（作名词更常用 sculpture）§sculpting career 雕塑生涯§§改译文：原译是另一句（布朗库西）的翻译，按英文重译

30297§sepia§ˈsiːpiə§n. 棕褐色；乌贼墨（颜料）；乌贼属 adj. 棕褐色的§Nina couldn't stop looking at the sepia-toned photograph in an oak frame.§尼娜忍不住一直看着橡木镜框里那张**棕褐色**调的照片。§Scientists, always eager to fill gaps in our understanding of the natural world, recently turned their attention to the Spotted Mediterranean Cuttlefish (Sepia delmarei), a peculiar cephalopod known for its unique hunting techniques, to determine if its visual perception is two or three dimensional.§科学家向来热衷于填补我们对自然界的认识空白，最近他们把注意力转向了斑点地中海**乌贼**（Sepia delmarei）——一种以独特捕猎技巧著称的头足类动物——以判定其视觉感知是二维还是三维。§§sepia-toned photograph 棕褐色调的照片（真题文学描写）；cuttlefish n. 乌贼；cephalopod n. 头足类（同域词）§sepsis 是「败血症」，形近异义§改例句：sepia-toned 的连字符误作破折号；改译文2：补漏译的学名 Sepia delmarei

30298§silhouette§ˌsɪluˈet§n. 剪影；轮廓；侧影 v. 使呈剪影状§Over the course of three years, Reiniger and her collaborators painstakingly made more than 250,000 individual images of hand-cut paper silhouettes and repeatedly had to invent entirely new methods and tools to create the special effects Reiniger envisioned.§三年间，Reiniger 与她的合作者呕心沥血制作了超过 25 万张手工剪纸**剪影**的单幅画面，还不得不一再发明全新的方法与工具，来实现她构想的特效。§§§§be silhouetted against the sky 在天空映衬下呈剪影；silhouetted adj. 呈剪影的；silhouettes of moss-covered trees 长满苔藓的树的剪影（真题复数用法）；outline / profile n. 轮廓 / 侧影（近义）§§改译文：「手剪纸影」意思含糊，改为「手工剪纸剪影」

30299§socioeconomic§ˌsəʊsiəʊˌekəˈnɒmɪk§adj. 社会经济的§Although these variations could be attributable to cultural factors, researchers have yet to thoroughly investigate that connection, and it remains unclear which cultural differences may be relevant or how they might interact with other socioeconomic conditions.§尽管这些差异可能归因于文化因素，研究者尚未深入考察这种关联；究竟哪些文化差异可能相关，它们又会如何与其他**社会经济**条件相互作用，目前仍不清楚。§§§socio-（社会）+ economic§socioeconomic status (SES) 社会经济地位（社科类固定术语）；socioeconomic groups / factors 社会经济群体 / 因素；demographic adj. 人口统计的（近域词）§sociocultural 是「社会文化的」§改译文：原译是另一句（消费革命论）的翻译，按英文重译

30300§solubility§ˌsɒljuˈbɪləti§n. 溶解度；可溶性§Given that in soil, metal solubility (a key determinant of plants' metal uptake) negatively correlates with soil pH in the rhizosphere (soil immediately proximate to roots), the researchers hypothesized that plants' total metal content would negatively correlate with soil pH, but instead they found no correlation between the two variables overall.§鉴于在土壤中，金属**溶解度**（植物吸收金属的关键决定因素）与根际（紧邻根部的土壤）的土壤 pH 呈负相关，研究者假设植物的金属总含量会与土壤 pH 呈负相关，但他们发现两个变量总体上并无相关性。§This compound’s low water solubility—0.044 grams per 100 milliliters at room temperature—means that considerable amounts of powdered lead iodide persist after standard recycling treatment with pure water.§该化合物极低的**水溶性**（室温下每 100 毫升仅溶 0.044 克）意味着：经过纯水标准回收处理后，仍有大量粉末状碘化铅残留。§soluble（可溶的）+ -ity§water solubility 水溶性；metal solubility 金属溶解度；soluble adj. 可溶的；insoluble adj. 不溶的；dissolve v. 溶解；solution n. 溶液§solvency 是「偿付能力」§改译文：原译是另一句（醋酸铅）的翻译，按英文重译
